existing_evidence_matrix.causal_use: Proves R1C is not necessary; cannot distinguish topic vs task structure vs general renderer.
Together with RF1_A only addresses R1C necessity.
Shows renderer can produce a more credible existing sample, but is confounded by topic, aspect/task wording and historical run conditions; cannot isolate topic.
Shows repeated tofu staging/density behavior but cannot certify absolute realism or isolate structure.

minimal_future_design.principle: Use existing RF1_A as the fixed tofu baseline. New images are sequential and conditional so each comparison changes exactly one variable.

stage_1.purpose: Test topic prior while holding renderer and RF1 task structure fixed.
fixed: same evaluation Golden and same four absolute gates
stage_1.candidate_topic_selection_rule: Use one already-demonstrated non-tofu working-process subject with existing credible historical evidence; rice granary is preferred because a prior sample exists, but the new task must preserve RF1 structure rather than reuse the historical rice prompt.
stage_1.prompt_policy: No extra realism instructions. Perform only semantic slot substitution needed to make the same task structure coherent for the non-tofu process.

pre_registered_interpretation.TOFU_FAIL_NONTOFU_PASS: TOPIC_CONDITION_STRONGLY_IMPLICATED; stop. Shared RF1 task structure and general renderer are not sufficient to explain failure under this matched comparison.
pre_registered_interpretation.TOFU_FAIL_NONTOFU_FAIL: TOPIC_ALONE_NOT_SUFFICIENT_TO_EXPLAIN; proceed only to Stage 2 because task structure vs general renderer remain unresolved.

stage_2_conditional.entry_condition: Stage 1 non-tofu candidate also FAILS absolute realism.
stage_2_conditional.purpose: Test shared-task structure while holding renderer and non-tofu topic fixed.
fixed: same Golden and same four absolute gates
stage_2_conditional.task_structure_change_definition: Remove structural instructions whose function is to organize evidence/hierarchy/context, while preserving the same required subject event and output geometry. Do not add documentary, anti-staging, realism, imperfection, material, lighting, or negative-prompt rules.

pre_registered_interpretation.STAGE1_FAIL_STAGE2_PASS: SHARED_RF1_TASK_STRUCTURE_STRONGLY_IMPLICATED; general renderer prior is not sufficient under the same topic.
pre_registered_interpretation.STAGE1_FAIL_STAGE2_FAIL: GENERAL_RENDERER_PRIOR_REMAINS_COMPATIBLE_BUT_NOT_PROVEN_AS_SOLE_CAUSE; stop. A renderer-switch experiment would be required for stronger attribution.

minimal_future_design.adaptive_expected_images: 1 if Stage 1 passes; 2 only if Stage 1 fails

preregistered_full_interpretation_table.allowed_claim: Matched topic substitution changes outcome under same renderer/task structure.
Matched task-structure change changes outcome for same non-tofu topic and renderer.
Neither topic substitution nor task-structure simplification rescued the matched test.

questions: Does Stage 1 change only topic content while preserving renderer, aspect, reference policy, RF1 structural functions and evaluation contract?
If Stage 1 fails, does Stage 2 change only task structure while keeping renderer, topic, aspect, reference policy and evaluator fixed?
Does Stage 2 avoid adding any realism/anti-AI/negative-prompt rules?
Are Stage 1 and Stage 2 sequential so Stage 2 is prohibited when Stage 1 already identifies topic sensitivity?
Is max new image budget hard-capped at 2 with zero retry, and is the second image conditional rather than automatic?
Do interpretation rules avoid claiming a sole/primary cause where the design cannot identify one?
audit_gate.known_residual_limit: Even Stage1 FAIL + Stage2 FAIL cannot prove a general renderer prior without changing renderer; it only leaves that explanation compatible and motivates a separate future renderer-switch experiment.

stop_conditions: Stop immediately if Stage 1 passes absolute realism; do not run Stage 2.
Stop after Stage 2 if Stage 1 and Stage 2 both fail; do not add a renderer switch under RF2.
Stop on any technical failure before generation without consuming extra image budget.
No retries, replacement images, third image, hidden variants, best-of-N or rerolls.
No new rules may be appended based on visual disappointment.

authorization_boundary.reason: Any Stage 1 image introduces a new topic variable and new image budget outside RF1. The user's standing policy explicitly excludes new experimental variables or expanded budget.
